content: Jesu Yokaniwa mu Nazaleta
Jesu aba na tunda omo mu sibaka, sebeli ota ku mundi waye, mi aiyetwa aye sebeli amwenda mu nyima.

Cwale elino Pumulo, sebeli otangisa okwiyeta aanu mu ndoo no milapelo no Majuda, mi ano kupula aba ana ku muyupa sebeli akomoka ni kwamba nji, “Kubine ana itundisa eyi wuyu mulume? Kaku shangama oko anabiwi? Kubine ana wana amaata no kutenda etimakazo ni maoko aye?
Kasa yokame osikwaya omwana Maliya, omukulwaa Jakobo, Jose, Juda ni Simoni? Amandaye kasaa, tuli noo? Mi kame ana sitatala mu libaka lyaye.
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Omunuhi wa Nyambe omu aulwa okukutekiwa mu naha yaye felea, kwasi lusika lwaye na sindoo yaye.”
Omo kasiku twesa okutendamo omusebezi no koongola, konji okubalisa aanu acana ana kutoma, mukwabeeka amaoko aye beulu ni kwa balisa.
Mi kame anaku komoka okwa pumena koo. Jesu Yotuma Aiyetwa ana Kukwana Likumi na Yiili (12) (Mateu10.5-15; Luka9.1-6) Cwale Jesu sebeli ota mu mindi ili beebi yoiyeta aanu.
Cwale Jesu sebeli oisana ano kukwana likumi na yiili, mi kame ana kwatuma mu wiili, mu wiili. Mi nikwaaba amaata beulu no mebo no kwakena,
sebeli walaela nji, “Mulese okushimba esinu sonje, konji omulamu, mulese okushimba esinkwa, omukotana, simba amali mu tipokoto tenu.
Mukumange einjatangwa yenu, mi mulese okushimba esikumango sinjili no wiili.”
Cwale kame sebeli waambela nji, “Mu ndoo yonje omo samwingene, mwikalemo okutwala aba sa mukatundemo.
Cwale omo mu ndoo sakane oku mitambula ni kumiyupa, mutundemo mututule amaluli ku makondo enu, otenda oupaki kwa onyene.
Cwale sebeli ata, mukwiyeta aanu nji abake.
Cwale sebeli acita amadimona no kupula, mi sebeli awaa amaati kwawo asikutoma no kupula, mane sebeli abala.
Olufu lwa Jowani Mukolobezi
Cwale Ombumu Heloda aba ana kuyupa ya Jesu, kakuli elitina lyaye naliku bubaana mi aanu sebeli aamba nji, “Jowani mukolobezi nainguka kwaafu, elibaka aba atenda etimakazo mwa yonyene.”
Anjili sebeli amba nji, “Yo kame Eliya,” Mi anjili nji omunuhi wa Nyambe, kanyi omunjili no anuhi a Nyambe na kukale.
Kono Heloda aba ana kuyupa ngeeso, sebeli wamba nji, “Yokame Jowani nina kupatula omutwi, nainguka kwaafu!”
Kakuli Heloda yona kutuma aanu okalema Jowani, ni kumununga okumubeka mu tolongo mulibkalya Helodiyasi omoywaa Filipi minaye, kakuli yonaku mukwata.
Jowani kame ana kwambela Heloda nji, “Katukelo yowe okukwata omoywaa minowe!”
Kakuli Helodiyasi kame ana kutimba onene Jowani mi sebeli osinga oku mwibaa, kono kame ana kukwangwa omusa mwiibaele.

Kakuli Heloda kame ana kucilanga Jowani, mukulimuka nji mulume no kuluka, mi ni wakukena. Mi kame na ku musilelezanga. Aba ana kuyupanga yo amba, kasi kuwabelelwanga mu mucima simba nji kame ana kumu teetetanga.
Ku mamaneneno Helodiyasi sebeli otandala okuwana esibaka, Heloda abana kutenda omukiti no kuleiwa kwaye, mi sesbeli oisanenako amanduna no kuta yaye na kulu no masole na kulu namu Galileya.

Cwale omwana Helodiyasi no mukatana abana kukeela sebeli onenga onene niku wabelisa Heloda naa ana kwikala naye ba tafule. Cwale Ombumu sebeli wambela omukatana munyonyo nji, “Okumbele esi sosinge kwa mene sonje, mi mbani kubi so.”
Mane sebeli okununga oluci nji, “Esi so kumbele sonje, simba eseemba no mubuso wange mbani kubi.
Cwale omukatana sebeli ota okaibanguta inawawe nji, “Ni kumbele eikene?” Inawawe sebeli omutambula nji, “Okumbele omutwi wa Jowani omukolobezi.”
Cwale ababo omukatana sebeli oukela kwa Mbumu muwanguwangu ni kukumbela nji, “Kame nisinga nji abano, onibe omutwi wa Jowani omukolobezi mu siwana.”
Cwale ombumu sebeli weena onene, kono mulibaka no kweeta oluci kwaye na ngenda awo ana kwikala naye, sebeli okwangwa okumatuka amaywi aye.
Ababo Ombumu sebeli otuma omunjili no masole no atateleli, niku laela nji akalite omutwi wa Jowani mukolobezi. Woyo sebeli ota nukapatula omutwi wa Jowani mukolobezi mu tolongo,
ni kulita omutwi mu siwana, ni kuuba omukatana, mi omukatana yonyene sebeli ouba inawaye.
Cwale aiyetwa a Jowani aba ana kuyupa etaba eyo, sebeli aiiya muku shimba esitupu saye oka siteula mu libita.
Jesu abana Kufepa Aanu no Kubitelela Eikiti Mutanu (5,000)
Atumiwa sebeli auka kwa Jesu, oka mwambela yonje eyo ana kutenda neyi ana kwiyeta aanu.

Cwale sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Mwiiye, tute ku mukunda muka pumuleko mbicani oku kuulwile aanu. Kakuli kame ku nakwikala aanu no kupula aa na iyanga ni kuuka mane kame ana kukwangwa ni nako no kulya.”
Cwale sebeli ata mu wato okaikala omboci mu sibaka no kondoka.
Cwale aanu no kupula sebeli aamona akatile, ni kwalimuka nji anyine, mi sebeli aitukelako ni makondo okutunda mu milenen̄i yonje, mi aanu sebeli aka keelako oweli Jesu na iyetwa aye asili munyima.
Cwale Jesu aba ana kutunda mu wato, sebeli omona aanu no kupula, mi sebeli wayupela amakeke, kakuli kame ana kufeka kanyi omukoko nambulwa mulisana. Mi sebeli otangisa okwaiyeta einu no kupula.
Cwale eliywaa aba lina kwiika, aiyetwa aye sebeli aiya kwa yonyene ni kwamba nji, “Sino ni sibaka no kondoka, mi enako yatakale.
Mwaa use, nji aka ku ulele eino kulya mu matema ni mu mindi ili beebi.”
Jesu sebeli waatambula nji, “Mwaabe eino kulya mwenyene, Onyene sebeli amwibanguta nji, “Tukaule einkwa no mali a atenda emianda yiili no muwayawaya nji twaabe alye?”
Cwale Jesu sebeli wamba kwa onyene nji, “Injinga einkwa mukwite? Mute muka imone. Cwale aba anaku imona, sebeli amba nji, “Kame kuli feela einkwa mutanu ni tindi timbili.”
Cwale sebeli olaela nji, “Aanu onje aikale mu ikwata, ba moopu no musuhela.”
Cwale aanu sebeli aikala banji mu ikwata, esinjili esikwata no aanu akwana omwaanda, anjili aanu ana ku kwana makumi mutanu.
Jesu sebeli oshimba einkwa mutanu ni tindi timbili, ni kwaliketa kuwilu, mi sebeli okutumela ni kupatola einkwa okuba aiyetwa aye nji atabele aanu, mi kame ni kutabela aanu etindi.
Cwale onje sebeli alya ni kwikuta.
Cwale sebeli ashimba amatanda likumi na yiili, ana kwiyala oubulumusi no inkwa, nou no tindi.
Mi awo ana kulya neli alume ana kukwana eikiti Mutanu (5,000).
Jesu aba na Enda ba Meyi
Ababo Jesu sebeli wambela aiyetwa aye nji aingene mu wato nji akutangete okuta mu linjaliya no lisa, ku Betisaida, yonyene yo suusa aanu.
Osimana felea okuusa aanu sebeli ota ba lilundu oka lapela.
Cwale enako no mangolwaa aba ina kukwana, owato owendela ba kaci no lisa, mi Jesu yoli yomboci ba likamba.
Mi sebeli omona nji kame apuwa me aziyelehile, kakuli emebo kame ina kwalwisa onene. Mi mu nako no malungasiku, Jesu sebeli oiya kwa onyene yo enda ba meyi, mi sebeli osinga okwabitelela.
Kono aba ana ku mumona yo enda ba meyi no lisa, sebeli akuwa onene nji ni silumba.
Cwale onje sebeli acila aba ana kumumona. Kono sebeli oleluba okwamba noo nji, “Mu koongote, ya meene, mu lese kucila.”
Cwale sebeli oku longa mu wato nonyene, mi emebo sebeli yondoka. Cwale aiyetwa aye sebeli akomoka onene.
Kakuli kasi ku yupisisa etaluso no kufepa aanu no kupula bokame abo emicima yoo kame ina koongola.
Jesu yo Balisa osi Kutoma mu Genesaleta
Cwale aba ana kumana okuluta elisa ni kuta ba likamba, mi sebeli akeela mu naha iisaniwa Genesaleta mi sebeli afuweka ku likamba.
Mi abana kutunda mu wato, ababo aanu sebeli amu limuka.
Cwale sebeli aitukela mu naha yonje ni kutangisa okalita asikutoma onje oko ana kuyupa nji Jesu kwaali.

Mi konje Jesu oku ana ku bita, mu mindi icana ni mu mindi inene, simba mwibaka no matema, asi kutoma kame ana kubeekiwa ba tipatelo, mi aanu kame ana kukumbela nji aa pumenene oku lema feela simba ku mungundo no sikumango saye, mi aa amulema onje kame abala.
